html: The registry's source is in the repository: every dataset version from v0.1 to v0.9.0, every rubric version, both admission policies, the conformance gate and the generator that builds these pages, so a reader can rebuild them from the same inputs the steward uses. A check refuses a page that no longer matches the committed dataset, rubric and generator. The dataset files and downloads from v0.3.0 are public projections of the released versions: each omits one record-level stewardship field that was null in every version and says so in its own public_projection block. No grade, status, evidence, citation or licence class changed.
